verdicts.title: Cauchy-Stieltjes kernels families and free multiplicative convolution
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we determine the effect of the free multiplicative convolution on the pseudo-variance function of a Cauchy-Stieltjes kernel family. We then use the machinery of variance functions to establish some limit theorems related to this type of convolution and involving the free additive convolution and the boolean additive convolution.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the effect of free multiplicative convolution on pseudo-variance functions of Cauchy-Stieltjes kernel families and related limit theorems — it shares the ⊠ framework but says nothing about Boolean matrices, communication complexity, or any defect lower bound on CC_R.

verdicts.title: Multiplicative Complexity of Vector Valued Boolean Functions

verdicts.title: Finite free probability and $S$ transforms of Jacobi processes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we study the $S$ transforms of Jacobi processes in the frameworks of free and finite free probability theories. We begin by deriving a partial differential equation satisfied by the free $S$ transform of the free Jacobi process, and we provide a detailed analysis of its characteristic curves.
